summary: Verified DrawGame.jsx bug fix for role-based chat visibility. Code review confirms: (1) Chat panel completely hidden for drawer via {!isDrawer && ...} conditional at line 821, (2) Guesser chat panel renders with data-testid='draw-guesser-chat-panel', (3) Canvas area unobstructed - no overlay elements, (4) Mobile responsive layout preserves chat visibility for guessers. ESLint passes. Live two-user game testing not possible in single-session environment, but code-level verification confirms fix is correct.
